name: Delicious Rimecurrant Ice Cream
desc: A dessert served in a glass. Look closely and you can just faintly discern the delicate textures of fruit pulp, looking like a tiny sliver of sunset trapped beneath the ice. While Snezhnaya's frozen climate could easily preserve this sweet scenery for an entire day, its flawless balance of sweet and tart ensures it will be devoured long before then...

value.text: Revives a character and restores 1,500 HP.
